config.title: 🎫 Ticket configuration — {server}
config.hint: Pick a reason in the menu to configure it (category, access, questions, welcome), or create a new one. Then publish the opening panel.
config.empty: No ticket reason yet. Create one with ➕ or use 📦 for the default reasons (Support, Bug, Shop…).
config.no_description: No description (text shown under the reason in the menu).
config.no_questions: No questions: only the title (and an optional message) is asked.
config.archive_placeholder: 🗄️ Closed tickets category for this reason (takes priority)…

config.defaults_exist: Reasons already exist: default reasons are only created on an empty server.
config.archive_cleared: Category specific to **{label}** removed: closed tickets go to the server “Closed tickets” category.
config.modal_description_help: Short text shown under the reason in the opening menu.
config.modal_name_format_help: Used when the typed title is unusable. Variables: {number} {username} {type}
config.questions_help: Only the label is required. Leave empty to remove. The ticket title is always asked first (4 questions max).
config.panel_hint: Choose the channel, the style and the included reasons, then publish.
config.no_enabled_types: No enabled reason: enable at least one before publishing.
config.panel_channel_placeholder: Channel where to publish the panel…
config.panel_types_all: All enabled reasons will be included.

open.title: {emoji} Ticket #{number} — {type}
open.description: Welcome {user}! Describe your request, the team will answer as soon as possible.
open.modal_title_placeholder: E.g. Cannot connect to the server

closed.title: 🔒 Ticket #{number} closed
closed.description: Closed by {user}. The channel is kept: the member and added people no longer have access.
closed.hint: **Staff**: 📄 generates the transcript and DMs it to the member · 🔓 reopens the ticket · 🗑️ deletes the channel (no transcript).
closed.hint_sent: ✅ Transcript saved and sent to the member. 🔓 reopens the ticket · 🗑️ deletes the channel.
closed.category_full: ⚠️ The {category} category is full (50 channels): the channel stayed where it was.
